name: Baniya Rasoi
summary: Simple, satvik vegetarian food from Agarwal & Baniya homes of North India: dal, seasonal sabzi, chilla and dalia.

foods.name: Arhar Dal & Rice
foods.blurb: Yellow toor dal with a jeera-hing tadka, served on soft rice.

foods.name: Lauki Chana Dal
foods.blurb: Bottle gourd cooked with chana dal. Light, cooling and filling.

foods.name: Moong Dal Chilla
foods.blurb: Savoury pancakes of ground moong dal, with ginger and coriander.

foods.name: Vegetable Dalia
foods.blurb: Broken wheat cooked soft with peas and carrots.

foods.name: Khatta-Meetha Kaddu
foods.blurb: Sweet-and-sour pumpkin with methi seeds and a touch of gur.

foods.name: Aloo Methi & Phulka
foods.blurb: Potatoes tossed with fresh fenugreek leaves, with hot phulkas.

foods.name: Sprouted Moong Chaat
foods.blurb: Sprouts with tomato, cucumber, lemon and chaat masala.

foods.name: Bathua Raita
foods.blurb: Winter greens folded into cool curd.

foods.name: Moong Dal Halwa
foods.blurb: A rich winter-wedding sweet made with lots of ghee and sugar.
